{{Quote|The Bank and the depositors of Aargau welcome you in the name of the sacred balance!|Aargau security captain|<ref name="MSW48">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref>}}
'''Aargau''' {{Pronounced|är-'gou}},<ref name="MSW48" /> also known as '''Zug''',<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref><ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 4.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-10-22}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Zug system/Legends|Zug system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region, not far from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It was run by and served as the headquarters for the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]], which was part of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Numerous other banks and corporations were also based on Aargau, including the [[Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation/Legends|Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation]]. Aargau was an exceptionally wealthy world, due both to its status as a financial center, as well as the planet's vast reserves of rare and precious metals, which were the basis of the value of the [[Imperial credit|Imperial Credit]].

Aargau was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from its discovery until the end of that [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power. After the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was considered a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold. The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] occupied by the planet would later fall under the hegemony of first the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and then subsequently [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Despite this, Aargau took a neutral approach to [[Politics/Legends|politics]], which meant that warring factions were mutually welcome to conduct business on the planet. The planetary government imposed, among others, three primary laws on citizens and visitors, called the [[Three Statutes of Aargau]]. These laws focused on the export of Aargau's natural resources, the absolute ban on weapons for visitors&mdash;and, conversely, the requirement to bear arms for Aargauuns&mdash;as well as maintaining the integrity of the Bank of Aargau. Breaking any of these rules was punishable by immediate [[Death/Legends|execution]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Better poor on Aargau than wealthy anywhere else.|Saying|<ref name="MoD" />}}
[[File:Laws.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Three Statutes of Aargau]].]]
Aargau occupied a central location in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region; not only was it in close proximity to the [[Politics/Legends|politically]] important world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it was also surrounded by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] such as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Agricultural Circuit|Ag Circuit]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> Thanks to this, combined with a culture fixated on banking and finance, as well as enormous reserves of valuable metals, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] became an [[Galactic economy|economic]] powerhouse.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Several governments, corporations, and organizations stored their assets in the planet's thousands of secure vaults.<ref name="MoD" />

Aargau's government, the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]], which in turn was owned by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], operated with only three primary laws called the [[Three Statutes of Aargau]], all of which were punishable with [[Death/Legends|death]] if broken. It was illegal to export Aargau's rare metals without proper approval, for non-Aargauuns to carry weapons&mdash;on the other hand, it was illegal for Aargauun citizens to be unarmed&mdash;and finally, it was unlawful to "defraud, discredit or deceive" the Bank of Aargau. The Bank's wholly owned subsidiary [[Bank of Aargau Security, Ltd.|Bank of Aargau Security]] was, at the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the largest privately owned army in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="wizards" /> The [[Aargau Home Guard]]<ref name="MSW48" /> frequently played war games around Aargau's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[New Escrow]]. This display of military power was meant to deter foreign powers from invading the planet, but in reality, Aargau's financial position already ensured this was an unpopular notion. Due to the planet's laws on export, the Bank of Aargau Security subsidiary [[BAS Customs]] strictly monitored all inbound and outgoing traffic.<ref name="wizards" />

Much of Aargau's surface was covered by [[City/Legends|city]],<ref name="CSWE" /> though far from all of it.<ref name="wizards" /> While the higher, newer levels of the cities were seat to the planet's political and financial power, the millions of years-old lower levels referred to as the [[Aargau Undercity|Undercity]], were home to a seedier element, which included members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] clan. Due to Aargau's unique laws, this group of people were free to conduct their somewhat shady business mostly in peace.<ref name="MoD" />

==History==
===Early history===
Aargauun history stretched back millions of [[Time/Legends|years]], to the construction of its first cities by the planet's original natives.<ref name="MoD" /> The existence of the enormous [[Dawn Pyramid of Aargau]]&mdash;considered by the historian [[Vicendi]] to be one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]&mdash;led some scientists to believe the planet had been visited by the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] civilization several thousands of years prior to the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Aargau was discovered by the Republic and the galactic community at large between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000]] and [[17,000 BBY]], in the period of time referred to as the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> Over time, [[Human/Legends|Humans]] came to be the dominant [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet,<ref name="wizards" /> and the Bank of Aargau became its planetary government.<ref name="MoD" /> It was considered a major financial center by [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="KOTOR11">[[Knights of the Old Republic 11|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 11]]</ref> and was in direct competition with the [[Telerath Interstellar Banking Initiative]] until [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] was abandoned during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR18">[[Knights of the Old Republic 18|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 18]]</ref>

[[File:AargauAccident-HNN.png|thumb|left|Aks Moe's speeder accident on Aargau.]]

===Clone Wars===
At some point around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' and [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 6|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 6]], [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]] was an early prototype of the [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 series]] fresh from [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries']] droid factories on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. Also, ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], including 4A-7's [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Aargau<ref name="Email" /> was the site of the [[North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /> [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] unveiled its first [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droids]] during the event, thus announcing its entry into the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] market.<ref name="TNEGtD" />

In 22 BBY, just prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] was killed in a bomb explosion in New Escrow. Moe was visiting the planet to negotiate a deal with the InterGalactic Banking Clan to secure funding for a proposed Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military initiative]] to deal with the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], which concerned a rapidly growing secessionist movement within the Republic itself.<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}}</ref> This [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|movement]] was suspected of being involved with Moe's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], but that claim was never proven.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_2.html|Moe's Bomb Identified}}</ref>

When the war broke out, Aargau retained its neutral stance, despite the fact that the Banking Clan were heavily involved in the war on the Separatist side. The Republic, fearful for its substantial investments, and suspecting the Banking Clan of manufacturing [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droids]] on the planet, [[Garrison/Legends|garrisoned]] a large peacekeeping force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in major cities, including the [[IBC Arcology (Aargau)|InterGalactic Banking Clan Arcology]]. This was not without controversy: technically, the Republic occupation broke one of the Three Statutes of Aargau, specifically the one stating no non-Aargauuns could carry weapons. Not before Aargau threatened to secede did the Republic send [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] envoys.<ref name="CIS">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref>

Republic intervention, however, did not stop the prominent Confederacy of Independent Systems official [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] from visiting the planet to attempt to recruit the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] to the Separatist cause&mdash;a meeting that, by chance, was witnessed by the future leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]],<ref name="BobaDB">{{DB|character|bobafett|Fett, Boba}}</ref> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="MoD" /> During the war, the neutral organization [[Aargau Medical Observer Corps]] investigated recent battlefields for evidence of war crimes. This inquisitional organ was tolerated by both sides of the conflict.<ref name="HoC">{{InsiderCite|issue1=68|issue2=70|Hero of Cartao}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
In the early days of the Galactic Empire, the [[Galactic Corporate Policy League/Legends|Galactic Corporate Policy League]] held a week-long meeting on Aargau in the famed [[Dragonbird Gardens]] to plan and write the [[Corporate Sector Authority Charter|charter]] proposing the establishment of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], a [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]-based interplanetary government focused on free enterprise.<ref name="Corporate Sector">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The planet retained its neutrality throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], which meant that both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and Galactic Empire could conduct business on the banking world. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Operation Third Law|attempted]] to secure a loan for the Alliance that would enable the organization to procure several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. The collateral presented for the loan were the priceless [[Crown Jewels of Alderaan/Legends|Crown Jewels of Alderaan]]. Imperial [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], also on Aargau at the time, feigned an attempt to stop Organa's financial transaction from going through. His actual objective was securing the crown jewels, which he promptly stole as soon as the Alliance's loan was approved.<ref name="MSW48" /> Both Organa and Vader were tried ''in absentia'' following this incident, and were recommended to be arrested should either of them return to the planet.<ref name="wizards" /> Vader also retained an account on Aargau, which Lando Calrissian hacked to place the embezzled funds from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hugo Treece]] into it as revenge for ther latter's backstabbing him and his use of slavery on Cloud City's Ugnaught populace.<ref name="MSW57">[[Star Wars (1977) 57|''Star Wars'' (1977) 57]]</ref>

During the [[Imperial Civil War]], a conflict that lasted from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]]<ref name="The Essential Chronology">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> Aargau became a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]], and was garrisoned with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisting of hundreds of [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="DESourcebook" /> Between [[10 ABY/Legends|10]] and [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], following the [[Cloning/Legends|resurrection]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a [[Battle of Aargau|battle]] between Imperial forces from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and the New Republic was fought on Aargau.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

===Later history===
Aargau completely avoided the destruction wrought by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] occupied by the planet fell under the political hegemony of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and later [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

==Inhabitants==
The original native people of Aargau were responsible for beginning construction on the world's many cities.<ref name="MoD" /> However, by the Galactic Civil War, Humans had become the dominant species on the planet,<ref name="wizards" /> although, as a major financial hub in the galaxy, thousands of other species were represented.<ref name="MoD" />

==Locations==
[[File:City1.jpg|thumb|150px|New Escrow]]

===IBC Arcology===
{{Main|IBC Arcology (Aargau)}}
The InterGalactic Banking Clan was based in a mammoth pyramid-shaped structure, which was subdivided into seven color-coded levels. The higher levels were reserved for finance and lodgings, while the lower levels were employed for logistical and entertainment purposes. The lowest level of the massive building contained Aargau's [[Aargau Undercity|Undercity]].<ref name="MoD" />

===New Escrow===
{{Main|New Escrow}}
Aargau's capital, New Escrow was a remarkably wealthy city, something that was evident in its unique and luxurious architecture. Air traffic in the capital was directed to a complex network of roads, which made it arguably somewhat safer than other similarly sized cities.<ref name="wizards" /> New Escrow was also home to the [[Garden of Butterflies]], a place where visitors could conduct business surrounded by a large collection of butterflies.<ref name="MSW48" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aargau was first introduced by writer [[Larry Hama]] in [[Star Wars (1977) 48|issue 48]] of [[Marvel Comics|Marvel's]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The planet was mentioned mostly in passing in later works. It was not until [[2003]]'s ''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]'' as well as the ''[[Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs]]'' article on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s website that Aargau was revisited, both sources substantially fleshing out the planet. Aargau's location was finally pinpointed in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.

On writing ''Boba Fett: Maze of Deception'', author [[Elizabeth Hand]] stated that she was given names and places that had to come into play, such as "[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]" or "Aargau." Since the planet existed within the ''Star Wars'' universe as only a name at the time, she was tasked with creating its history, ecology and culture.<ref name="awakensnovelreview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/entertainment/books/youve-seen-the-new-star-wars-movie--should-you-read-the-book-tie-in/2015/12/20/40791cf2-a726-11e5-bff5-905b92f5f94b_story.html?utm_term=.0a1bb68b59bb|text=You've seen the new 'Star Wars' movie — should you read the book tie-in?|author=Hand, Elizabeth|date=2015-12-21|archivedate=20180216000044}}</ref>

A planet Zug was mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2006]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TNEGtD" /> However, the 2003 ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' article ''Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs'' indicated that the Zug system did not contain any planet named Zug. The creation of the planet appears to have been an error as no other pre-existing source has been identified as containing a planet named Zug. Daniel Wallace's 2006 endnotes for ''The New Essential Guide to Droids'' in which he states that Zug was a "pre-existing ''Star Wars'' planet" rather than a star appears to have stemmed from Wookieepedia itself only listing Zug as simply a "primary" until 2007 when the entry for [[Zug]] was changed to being a "primary star", matching its established description as the star of the Zug system in ''Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs''.<ref name="wizards" /> The connection between the planet Zug and the Zug system was not clarified until [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated that Zug was simply an alternate name for Aargau.<ref name="Email" />

Both [[wikipedia:Aargau|Aargau]] and [[wikipedia:Canton of Zug|Zug]] are names of [[wikipedia:Cantons of Switzerland|cantons of Switzerland]], a country known for [[wikipedia:Banking in Switzerland|its banking system]].
